text:
Asking rents in Nuremberg stand at a median of 12.89 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.0% on the year and +23.3% over five years. That ranks Nuremberg #14 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 57% above the 2022 average contract rent of 8.21 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 773 € a month in cold rent, 17.1% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 31 days and 18% are gone within a week; with 1.6% market-active vacancy and +1.5% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 13.55 €/m² (+5.1%), with an 80% range of 13.24 to 13.85 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
